documented: The pinned upstream generic rule supplies its complete matching expression, keyword hints, capture group 1 and strict entropy threshold 3.5.
Pinned allowlist semantics distinguish secret, full-match and complete-line regex targets; stopwords remain secret-targeted and OR groups independently suppress generic candidates.
assumptions: Synthetic source-contract fixtures establish offline detector behavior only; they are not issuer-generated credentials or evidence of validity, active authorization, or complete provider conformance.

This ordinary additional catalog heuristic requires assignment context inside the scanned value, never an attribute name; it does not change provider or custom-rule acceptance or introduce fallback priority.

Generic alone imports applicable pinned rule-specific secret/match/line filters and default global value regex/stopword filters. Stopwords always target the captured secret after Unicode lowercasing, not regexp simple folding.

File and commit exclusions and inline gitleaks:allow directives are not imported. The upstream AND group requiring a BitBake path is inapplicable without that evidence; its line expressions are not promoted to unconditional exclusions.

Line filtering preserves pinned value-only location semantics and original offsets, including prefix retention for an unterminated last-line match and truncation at a multiline match ending on that line; it does not manufacture bounded candidate-window context.
Entropy must strictly exceed 3.5. Character classes, widths, capture and delimiters are the pinned matching contract, not an issuer format claim.

The former cache-identifier rejection fixture is a known synthetic nonsecret collision: both pinned Gitleaks and the native generic heuristic report it. It remains an explicit diagnostic, not a proof of an issued credential or zero false positives.
evidence.fixture_method: Hand-authored deterministic synthetic assignment candidates and independent nonsecret/context mutations from the pinned scanner contract; no issuer generator, live credential call, or online validation. Diagnostic carrier forms have no accuracy polarity.
